g.title: W1
g.text: OLED branch. Length terminal-to-terminal, tol +/-5 mm.

g.title: W2
g.text: Sensor branch. Length terminal-to-terminal, tol +/-5 mm.

g.title: X_OLED
g.text: 4 x Crimp terminal, DuPont 2.54 female, 22-28 AWG

g.title: label_notes
g.text: 1. Wire 28 AWG UL1571 (OD 0.8-1.0 mm to suit SZH-002T-P0.5). Lengths +/-5 mm, terminal to terminal.
2. Wires loose (no sleeve); twist each branch lightly is OK. Colours per photos of current build.
3. ASSUMED: OLED header order GND-VCC-SCL-SDA (GME12864-11 type). Confirm vs. supplied module silkscreen.
4. Sensor: Sharp GP2Y0A51SK0F (from CAD); ZH 3-pin per Sharp datasheet - verify with sample. (Sharp Vcc spec 4.5-5.5 V; board feeds 3V3 - design note, not a harness change.)
5. Battery NOT in this harness: 702035 cell with own leads + JST PH 2.0 2P plug (PHR-2) to J6. J6 pin1 = VBAT(+), pin2 = GND.
6. 100% continuity test; pull test per JST spec.
